name: Bénye (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Bénye (a blue and green shield with a bunch of grapes, ears of grain and a ploughshare) above a yellow scroll inscribed BÉNYE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
